title: Spring 2026 Examination Timetable: Year 2 Biosciences

headings.text: Add the timetable to your calendar

key_sentences: Candidates must be seated ten minutes before the start of each examination.
Rooms are subject to change, so check the noticeboard on the morning of each paper.
Thursday 21 May is kept free as a reserve day in case an examination has to be rescheduled.
If you are ill on the day of an examination, contact the School office before the paper starts.
Each examination is also published as a calendar entry that you can import into most calendar applications.

list_items.text: Bring your student card; you will not be admitted without it.
Only clear pencil cases and clear water bottles are allowed on desks.
Mobile phones must be switched off and left in the bag area.
Calculators must be on the approved list published by the School.
You may not leave during the first 30 minutes or the last 15 minutes of a paper.
